w: This morning Swamishri visited the famous Govind Dev Mandir, old Swaminarayan mandir and the BAPS hari mandir for darshan. Swamishri attended and blessed the evening satsang assembly in Hindi.

At 12.40 pm Shri Raghuna Anant Mashlikar, Director General of CSIR (Council for Scientific and Industrial Research) and a renowned scientist, met Swamishri after seeing Akshardham. He said, “After seeing everything here I felt in my heart that I am an Indian.”
51 devotees from Vallabhipur, 35 from Pachchhegam and 4 from Ratanpar. 375 from Bhavnagar (80 km).
